questions.question: 19012. Most of the people of Bangladesh are poor. What type of part of speech is 'most'?
questions.explain: Most অর্থ এখানে অধিকাংশ, যা কতগুলো মানুষের পরিবর্তে ব্যবহৃত হচ্ছে।

questions.question: 19011. The beast in him started working. What type of Noun is 'beast'?
questions.explain: এখানে beast বলতে পশুত্ব বুঝাচ্ছে, তাই এটা Abstract Noun.

questions.question: 19010. Which one is wrong about John Milton?
questions.option1: ক) the greatest writer of Jacobean period
questions.explain:
John Milton (1608 - 1674):
The greatest writer of The Jacobean period.
He was called an 'Epic poet'
Epic: 'Paradise Lost', 'Paradise regained'.
Other works: Of education,On Shakespeare, Comus Lycidas.
He was not a University Wit.
Source: LiveMCQ Lecture

questions.question: 19009. শ, ষ, স - এই তিনটি বর্ণে দ্যোতিত ধ্বনি কী জাতীয়?
questions.explain:
শ, ষ ও স - এই তিনটি বর্ণে দ্যোতিত ধ্বনি অঘোষ অল্পপ্রাণ এবং 'হ' ধ্বনিটি - ঘোষ মহাপ্রাণ।
উৎস: বাংলা ভাষার ব্যাকরণ, নবম-দশম শ্রেণি।

questions.question: 19008. কোনটি কাজী নজরুল ইসলাম রচিত গ্রন্থ?
questions.explain:
কাজী নজরুল ইসলাম রচিত কাব্যগ্রন্থ - নতুন চাঁদ।
'কন্যাকুমারী' আব্দুর রাজ্জাক রচিত উপন্যাস।
'গড্ডলিকা' রাজশেখর বসু রচিত গল্পগ্রন্থ এবং
'কালান্তর' রবীন্দ্রনাথ ঠাকুর রচিত প্রবন্ধগ্রন্থ।

questions.question: 19007. নিচের যে উপন্যাসের গ্রামীণ সমাজ জীবনের চিত্র প্রাধান্য লাভ করেনি-
questions.explain:
বঙ্কিমচন্দ্র চট্টোপাধ্যায়ের সর্বশেষ উপন্যাস সীতারাম। এতে এক ব্যক্তির পারিবারিক জীবন প্রাধান্য পেয়েছে, গ্রামীণ সমাজ জীবনের চিত্র প্রাধান্য লাভ করেনি। অন্যগুলোতে গ্রামীণ জীবনের প্রাধান্য লাভ করেছে।
উৎস: শীকর বাংলা প্রশ্ন-পাঠ, মোহসীনা নাজিলা।

questions.question: 19006. 'প্রবোধচন্দ্রিকা' গ্রন্থের রচয়িতা-
questions.explain:
মৃত্যুঞ্জয় বিদ্যালঙ্কার রচিত গ্রন্থ- বত্রিশ সিংহাসন, হিতোপদেশ, রাজাবলি, প্রবোধচন্দ্রিকা ও বেদান্ত চন্দ্রিকা।
উৎস: শীকর বাংলা প্রশ্ন-পাঠ, মোহসীনা নাজিলা।

questions.question: 19005. আধুনিক যুগের কোন কবি মর্সিয়া সাহিত্য রচনা করেন?
questions.explain:
আধুনিক যুগে মীর মোশারফ হোসেন ও কায়কোবাদ মর্সিয়া সাহিত্য রচনা করেন।
আরবি 'মর্সিয়া' শব্দটির অর্থ শোক। শোকবিষয়ক রচনাকে মর্সিয়া সাহিত্য বা শোককাব্য বলা হয়। এটি মূলত কারবালা ও ইসলামী বিয়োগান্তক কাহিনী নিয়ে রচিত।
মীর মশাররফ হোসেনের 'বিষাদ সিন্ধু' ও কায়কোবাদের 'মহাশ্মশান' এই ধারার কাব্য বিবেচনা করা হয়।
উৎস: লাইভ এমসিকিউ লেকচার ও ড. সৌমিত্র শেখর রচিত বাংলা ভাষা ও সাহিত্য জিজ্ঞাসা।

questions.question: 19004. 'গীতরত্ন' কি?
questions.explain:
বাংলা টপ্পা সংগীতের প্রবর্তক রামনিধি গুপ্ত। তাঁর ডাকনাম নিধু বাবু।
রামনিধি গুপ্তের টপ্পা সংগীত সংকলনের নাম 'গীতরত্ন'।
তাঁর রচিত টপ্পা সংগীতের বিখ্যাত পঙক্তি - নানান দেশের নানান ভাষা, বিনে স্বদেশী ভাষা, পুরে কি আশা?.........................।
উৎস: লাইভ এমসিকিউ লেকচার।

questions.question: 19003. বাংলা কবিতায় আধুনিকতা আনায়ন করেন কে?
questions.explain:
বাংলা কবিতায় আধুনিকতা আনেন কবি মাইকেল মধুসূদন দত্ত।
শুধু কবিতায় নয়, তিনি আধুনিকতা আনেন নাটক ও প্রহসনেও।
তার মতো প্রতিভাবান কবি বাংলা সাহিত্যে আছেন মাত্র আর একজন, তিনি রবীন্দ্রনাথ ঠাকুর।
মধুসূদন বাংলা মহাকাব্য রচনা করে বাংলা কবিতার রূপ বদলে দিয়েছিলেন।
উৎসঃ লাল নীল দীপাবলী, ড. হুমায়ুন আজাদ।

questions.question: 19002. নিচের কোন বাক্যটিতে 'কার্যপরম্পরা' বোঝাতে অসমাপিকা ক্রিয়ার ব্যবহার হয়েছে?
questions.option1: ক) একবার মরলে কি কেউ ফেরে?
questions.option2: খ) এখন বৃষ্টি হলে ফসলের ক্ষতি হবে।
questions.option3: গ) চারটা বাজলে স্কুলের ছুটি হবে।
questions.explain:
'ইলে' > 'লে' বিভক্তিযুক্ত অসমাপিকা ক্রিয়ার কয়েকটি ব্যবহার -
- কার্যপরম্পরা বোঝাতে -- চারটা 'বাজলে' স্কুলের ছুটি হবে।
- প্রশ্ন বা বিস্ময় জ্ঞাপনে -- একবার 'মরলে' কি কেউ ফেরে?
- সম্ভাব্যতা অর্থে -- এখন বৃষ্টি 'হলে' ফসলের ক্ষতি হবে।
- সাপেক্ষতা বোঝাতে -- তিনি 'গেলে' কাজ হবে।
উৎসঃ বাংলা ভাষার ব্যাকরণ, নবম-দশম শ্রেণী।

questions.question: 19001. 'মরণ রে, তুঁহু মম শ্যাম সমান'- চরণটির রচয়িতা-
questions.explain:
রবীন্দ্রনাথ ঠাকুরের 'ভানুসিংহ ঠাকুরের পদাবলী'র অন্তর্গত লেখা- 'মরণ রে, তুঁহু মম শ্যাম সমান! মেঘ বরণ তুঝ, মেঘ জটাজুট, রক্ত কমল কর.....।'
উৎস: শীকর বাংলা প্রশ্ন-পাঠ, মোহসীনা নাজিলা।

questions.question: 19000. The play ‘Arms and the Man’ is written by-
questions.explain:
George Bernard Shaw (1856-1950): Irish comic dramatist, literary critic, and socialist propagandist, winner of the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1925.
Famous Plays of G.B. Shaw are- Pygmalion, Mrs. Warren’s Profession, Arms and the Man, Heartbreak House, Caesar and Cleopatra, Man and Superman, The Doctor’s Dilemma, St. Joan of Arc etc.
[Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman and Britannica]

questions.question: 18999. ‘Adam’ and ‘Eve’ is the character of-
questions.explain:
John Milton (1608–74): He is considered the most significant English writer after William Shakespeare.
-He is called ‘Epic Poet’ and also called 'A great master of verse in Puritan Period'.
-His famous Epics are- Paradise Lost and Paradise Regained.
-Paradise Lost is an epic poem in blank verse, one of the late works by John Milton, originally issued in 10 books in 1667. It tells the biblical story of the fall from grace of Adam and Eve (and, by extension, all humanity) in language that is a supreme achievement of rhythm and sound.
The main characters in the poem are God, Lucifer (Satan), Adam, and Eve.
[Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopaedia Britannica]

questions.question: 18998. Choose the correct sentence:
questions.option1: ক) He is junior to me
questions.option2: খ) He is junior from me
questions.option3: গ) He is junior than me
questions.option4: ঘ) He is junior by me
questions.explain:
Latin Comparative (senior, junior, major, minor) এর পরে to বসে।
যেমন, He is senior to me for five years.

questions.question: 18997. Choose the correct sentence:
questions.option1: ক) Sagor and Jamil meet yesterday
questions.option2: খ) Sagor and Jamil had met yesterday
questions.option3: গ) Sagor and Jamil met yesterday
questions.option4: ঘ) Sagor and Jamil has been met yesterday
questions.explain:
Yesterday একটি অতীত নির্দেশক Adverb যা past indefinite tense নির্দেশ করে।
সুতরাং সঠিক বাক্য Sagor and Jamil met yesterday।
আরো কিছু অতীত নির্দেশক শব্দ হলো - last, last night, last day, ago, long since, last year, etc.

questions.question: 18996. Who wrote ‘The Canterbury Tales’?
questions.explain:
Geoffrey Chaucer: Father of Modern English poetry.
-His ‘The Canterbury Tales’ ranks as one of the greatest poetic works in English.
His famous poetry: The House of Fame, The Legend of Good Women, The Parliament of Fowls, The Nun's Priest's Tale, The Book of the Duchess.
[Source: Live MCQ Lecture]

questions.question: 18995. E.M. Forster’s literary work ‘A Passage to India’ is a-
questions.explain:
E.M. Forster(1879-1970): In full Edward Morgan Forster. British novelist, essayist, and social and literary critic. His fame rests largely on his novels ‘Howards End (1910)’ and ‘A Passage to India (1924)’.‘A Passage to India’ examines racism and colonialism.
Foster's other works:
- Aspects of Novel
- Where Angels Fear to Tread
- The Longest Journey
- A Room With a View
- The Celestial Omnibus(Collection of short stories).
Walt Whitman is an American poet, essayist and journalist. His famous works: A Passage To India(Poem).
[Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopaedia Britannica]

questions.question: 18994. Which of the following is a novel written by Chinua Achebe?
questions.option3: গ) A Tale of Two Cities
questions.explain:
Chinua Achebe(1930-2013):
-One of the world's most widely recognized and praised Nigerian novelists.
-Chinua Achebe wrote some of the most extraordinary works of the 20th century.
‘Arrow of God’ novel by Achebe
His other Notable works: Things Fall Apart (1958), No Longer at Ease, A Man of the People, Anthills of the Savannah.

'A Tale of Two Cities' is a novel written by Charles Dickens.
‘Robinson Crusoe’ is a Novel written by Daniel Defoe.
‘The sun also rises’is a novel written by Ernest hemingway.
[Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopaedia Britannica]

questions.question: 18993. Choose the correctly spelt word -
questions.explain:
সঠিক বানানের শব্দটি হলো - Conquer; যার অর্থ - জয় করা; শক্তিবলে দখল করা।
Source: Bangla Academy Accessible Dictionary

questions.question: 18992. Of the following authors, who wrote an epic?
questions.explain:
Edmund Spenser is known as the 'Poet of Poets' in English literature.
His famous Epic is ‘The Faerie Queene’.
His famous books- The Shepherds Calendar, The Ruins of Time, Amoretti (Collection of 89 Sonnets).
[Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture]

questions.question: 18991. Choose the correct sentence:
questions.option1: ক) I, you and he will go cox's bazar
questions.option2: খ) You, he and I will go cox's bazar
questions.option3: গ) He, you and I will go cox's bazar
questions.option4: ঘ) You, I and he will go cox’s bazar
questions.explain:
কোন sentence এ একাধিক pronoun থাকলে, প্রথমে 'second person', তারপর 'third person' এবং শেষে 'first person' বসে।
যেমন: You, he and I are present.
কিন্তু দোষ স্বীকার করলে অথবা অপরাধ স্বীকার করলে প্রথমে 'first person', তারপর 'second person', এবং শেষে 'third person' বসে।
যেমন: I, you and he are guilty.

questions.question: 18990. She gave me a watch which was expensive. (make it simple)
questions.option1: ক) She gave me a watch and it was expensive.
questions.option2: খ) She gave me an expensive watch.
questions.option3: গ) She gave me a watch that was expensive.
questions.option4: ঘ) An expensive watch she gave me.
questions.explain: Simple sentence এ একটি মাত্র Finite verb থাকে। তাই সঠিক উত্তর হবে, She gave me an expensive watch.

questions.question: 18989. The literary work ‘Wuthering Heights’ is -
questions.option1: ক) a drama by Oscar Wilde
questions.option2: খ) a short-story by Somerset Maugham
questions.option4: ঘ) A novel by Emily Bronte
questions.explain:
Emily Brontë was an English novelist and poet who wrote a single novel, Wuthering Heights (1847), a highly imaginative work of passion and hate set on the Yorkshire moors. The novel was published in 1847 under the pseudonym Ellis Bell.
[Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica]

questions.question: 18988. Who is known as “Opium Eater”?
questions.explain:
Samuel Taylor Coleridge (1772–1834): He is called the “poet of Supernaturalism”. He is also called the “Lake poet” and “Opium Eater”.
Major works: Biographia Literaria (1833) (prose), The Rime of Ancient Mariner (1798), Kubla Khan, Christabel, Dejection: An ode.
[Source: LiveMCQ Lecture]

questions.question: 18987. A person who knows several foreign language well is called -
questions.explain:
Polyglot: speaking or using several different languages.
Linguist: someone who studies foreign languages or can speak them very well, or someone who teaches or studies linguistics.
Erudite: having or containing a lot of knowledge that is known by very few people.
Source: Cambridge Dictionary

questions.question: 18986. Which one of the following is a Comedy by Shakespeare?
questions.explain:
William Shakespeare was an English dramatist and poet of the sixteenth century. He is known mostly for his plays.
Notable comedy of William Shakespeare: Twelfth night, The Taming of the Shrew, Two gentlemen of Verona, The Merchant of Venice, As you like it, All's well that ends well, A Midsummer Night Dreams, The Tempest.
Shakespeare's Tragedy: Julius Caesar (1599), Antony and Cleopatra (1606), Titus Andronicus, Romeo and Juliet (1594), Hamlet (1601), Troilus and Cressida, Othello (1604), Macbeth (1605), King lear (1605). Timon of Athens.
[Source: LiveMCQ Lecture]

questions.question: 18985. “Who planted this tree here?” the correct passive voice of this sentence is -
questions.option1: ক) By whom this tree was planted here?
questions.option2: খ) By whom was this tree planted here?
questions.option3: গ) This tree was planted here by whom?
questions.option4: ঘ) by whom had the tree been planted here?
questions.explain:
'Who planted this tree here'? এর সঠিক passive voice হবে By whom was this tree planted here?
'Who had planted this tree here'? এর সঠিক passive voice হবে By whom had the tree been planted here?
Who যুক্ত sentence এর passive voice করার structure- by whom + auxiliary verb + subject + verb এর past participle form + বাকী অংশ (যদি থাকে)।

questions.question: 18984. Choose the correct sentence:
questions.option1: ক) No sooner had I reached the station then the train left.
questions.option2: খ) No sooner had I reached the station than the train left.
questions.option3: গ) No sooner had I reached the station when the train left.
questions.option4: ঘ) No sooner had I reach the station then the train left.
questions.explain:
No sooner had - than, scarcely had – when, hardly had – before এর প্রথম অংশ Past Perfect ও Verb এর Past Participle হয় এবং ২য় অংশে Past Indefinite হয়।
যেমনঃ No sooner had we reached the station than the train left.
Hardly had the train stopped before we got down.
Scarcely had we started when it began to rain.

questions.question: 18983. ‘Ozymandias’ is a famous sonnet by-
questions.explain:
Percy Bysshe Shelley (1792 – 1822):
-This English poet was an atheist and expelled from Oxford University in 1811 due to his publication of a pamphlet named “The necessity of Atheism”.
-He believed that only revolution can change our society. So that he is called “Revolutionary Poet”.
-He is also called “The poet of Hope and Regeneration”.
-Shelly mourns over the death of John Keats in his famous elegy “Adonais”.
Famous Books: Prometheus Unbound (1820), Adonais (1821), A Defense of poetry (1820), The Revolt of Islam.
‘Ozymandias’ is a famous sonnet by Percy Bysshe Shelley, published in 1818. One of Shelley’s most famous short works, the poem offers an ironic commentary on the fleeting nature of power. Other famous poems: Ode to the West Wind, To a skylark, Alastor, Ozymandias, Queen Mab, The cloud.
[Source: LiveMCQ Lecture]

questions.question: 18982. Which word can be used both as verb and noun?
questions.explain:
Fool -
(noun): He's a fool;
(verb): Don't be fooled by his appearance;
(adjective): I made a damn fool mistake.

Poor -
(noun): She gives a lot of money to the poor;
(adjective): He came from a poor immigrant family.

Ear -
(noun): She's deaf in her left ear.

Famous -
(adjective): a famous actor.

Source: Cambridge Dictionary

questions.question: 18981. What is the adjective form of the word ‘Heart’?
questions.explain:
Hearten (verb) - উৎসাহ দেওয়া; উল্লসিত করা।
Heartily (adverb) - সানন্দে; পূর্ণোদ্যমে; হৃষ্টচিত্তে।
Heartful - (কোন শব্দ নেই)
Heartening (adjective) - উৎসাহব্যঞ্জক; উল্লাসজনক।
Source: Bangla Academy Accessible Dictionary

questions.question: 18980. “I knew his name” - transform the sentence into complex structure.
questions.option1: ক) What was his name, i know that.
questions.option2: খ) I knew what his name was.
questions.option3: গ) I know what his name is.
questions.option4: ঘ) His name was known by me.
questions.explain:
একটি complex sentence এ একটি principal clause এবং একটি subordinate clause থাকে।
Subordinate clause টি if, although, before, who, which, what, whom, after, since, that ইত্যাদি দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়।
গঠন এবং Tense অনুসারে সঠিক complex বাক্যটি হবে - I knew what his name was.

questions.question: 18979. ‘University Wits’ appeared in which period?
questions.explain:
University wits are a group of young dramatists who wrote and performed in London towards the end of the 16th century during the Elizabethan Period. Thomas Kyd, John Lyly, Robert Greene, George Peele, Christopher Marlowe and Thomas Nashe are university wits.
[source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman]

questions.question: 18978. A letter may consist of __ parts.
questions.explain:
There are six parts in a letter. These are -
1. Heading of the letter,
2. Salutation or Greetings,
3. The body of the letter,
4. The subscription,
5. The signature of the writer and
6. The superscription of address.

questions.question: 18977. Which is the first monument of English literature?
questions.explain:
Beowulf, heroic poem, the highest achievement of Old English literature(England) and the earliest European vernacular epic. It is also the first monument in English literature.
Major literary works of The Anglo-Saxon Period: The Wanderer, The Seafarer, the Husband’s Message, and The Wife’s Lament.
‘The Anglo-Saxon Chronicle’ written in this age is the earliest prose of English literature.
[Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica and An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman]

questions.question: 18976. Among the five boys, Mujib is __ intelligent.
questions.explain:
দুয়ের মধ্যে তুলনা বুঝালে adjective এর comparative form হয়। কিন্তু এর বেশি হলে superlative form ব্যবহার করতে হয়। এবং superlative degree এর পূর্বে ‘the’ article বসে।
সুতরাং, Among the five boys, Mujib is the Most intelligent হবে সঠিক উত্তর।

questions.question: 18975. “Rome was not built in a day.” the correct active voice of this sentence is -
questions.option1: ক) Rome did not build in a day.
questions.option2: খ) A day was not built by Rome.
questions.option3: গ) The Romans did not build Rome in a day.
questions.option4: ঘ) The Romans did not built Rome in a day.
questions.explain:
“Rome was not built in a day.” - এখানে subject ‘Rome’ কিন্তু object দেয়া নেই বা object টা এখানে উহ্য আছে। Rome সাম্রাজ্য যেহেতু Roman রা তৈরি করেছে, তাই active করার সময় subject হিসেবে The Romans ব্যবহার করতে হবে।
এ ধরনের past indefinite tense এ থাকা negative passive বাক্যকে Active বাক্যে রূপান্তর করার structure হবে - sub + did not + v1 + sub কে obj + ex.

questions.question:
18974. Select the right compound structure of the sentence:
“though he is rich, he is stingy.”
questions.option1: ক) He is rich and stingy
questions.option2: খ) As he is rich, he is stingy
questions.option3: গ) Since he is rich, he is stingy
questions.option4: ঘ) He is rich but stingy
questions.explain: Complex sentence এ though/although থাকলে compound sentence এ but থাকে। সুতরাং সঠিক বাক্যটি হবে - He is rich but stingy (সে ধনী কিন্তু কৃপণ।)

questions.question: 18973. Choose the correct sentence:
questions.option1: ক) If I was a rich man, I will help the poor.
questions.option2: খ) If I were a rich man, I will help the poor.
questions.option3: গ) If I was a rich man, I would help the poor.
questions.option4: ঘ) If I were a rich man, I would help the poor.
questions.explain: If যুক্ত clause টি যদি unreal past অর্থাৎ যদি হত (আসলে হয় নি) এমন অর্থ প্রকাশ করে তাহলে be verb এর স্থলে were বসে, এবং main clause টি past form (would) এ হয়।

questions.question: 18972. ‘Lotus Eaters’ is a poem written by-
questions.explain:
Lord Alfred Tennyson was a Victorian Poet and playwright.
His famous poems are Oenone, Ulysses, Lotus Eaters, Locksley Hall, Tears Idle Tears, Tithonus, The Two Voices, The Lady of Shalott, Vision of Sin, Morte D'Arthur etc.
The Falcon, Queen Mary, Harold are the famous comedies of Lord Alfred Tennyson.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and Encyclopedia Britannica.

questions.question: 18971. ‘To Helen’ is a famous poem written by-
questions.explain:
Edgar Allan Poe(1809–49): American short-story writer, poet, critic, and editor who is famous for his cultivation of mystery and the macabre.
His best-known works include the poems- “To Helen” (1831), “The Raven” (1845), and “Annabel Lee” (1849);
The short stories of wickedness and crime- “The Tell-Tale Heart” (1843) and “The Cask of Amontillado” (1846);
Supernatural horror story- “The Fall of the House of Usher” (1839).
His some other notable works are:
- The Black Cat
- The Masque of the Red Death
- The Murders in the Rue Morgue
[Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopaedia Britannica]

questions.question: 18970. ‘The Excursion’ is a literary work of -
questions.explain:
William Wordsworth (1770–1850): English Romantic poet. He is called Poet of Nature, Poet of Childhood, Lake poet.
Major Works: Lyrical Ballad (1798), The Daffodils, The prelude (1850), Lucy poem, Tintern Abbey, The Solitary Reaper, The Excursion.
[Source: Live MCQ Lecture]

questions.question: 18969. The peak of importance in a_____ is called climax.
questions.explain:
The peak of importance in a play or story is called climax. At this point the rise of action ends and the fall of action begins. For example: Antigone’s death is the climax of Oedipus.
[Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman.]

questions.question: 18968. “Speech is great, but silence is greater.” is a quote by-
questions.explain:
Thomas Carlyle(1795-1881): Scottish historian and essayist.
Major works: The French Revolution, Sartor Resartus.
His famous quotation-
-'Speech is great, silence is greater'
-'Popular opinion is the greatest lie'.
[Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopaedia Britannica]

questions.question: 18967. Who has written the poem ‘The Vanity of Human Wishes’?
questions.explain:
Dr. Samuel Johnson(1709-1784): Father of English Dictionary. He is the first lexicographer in English.
His famous books- A Preface to Shakespeare, Rasselas: Prince of Abissinia, Life of the English Poets etc.
His famous poem-The Vanity of Human Wishes.
[Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.]

questions.question: 18966. ‘The conquest of Granada’ is written by-
questions.explain:
John Dryden is the Father of Modern English Criticism.
His famous works are- All for Love, The Indian Emperor, Aureng-Zebe, The Mistaken Husband, Absalom and Achitophel, MacFlecknoe, The essay of Dramatic Poesy, The Conquest of Granada, The Medal of John Bays.
[Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ lecture.]

questions.question: 18965. Which of the following is not a Walt Whitman's poem?
questions.explain:
Walt Whitman(1819-1892): American poet, journalist, and essayist.
His famous works: A Passage To India (poem), Leaves of Grass, Drum-Taps, O Captain! My Captain!, Songs of Myself etc.
‘The Road not Taken’ is a famous poem of Robert Frost.
[Source: Live MCQ Lecture.]

questions.question: 18964. ‘Morte d' Arthur’ is the first romance in prose written by-
questions.explain:
‘Morte d'Arthur’ is the first romance in prose completed by Sir Thomas Malory about 1470 and printed by William Caxton in 1485.
‘Morte D' Arthur’ poem written by Lord Alfred Tennyson.
[Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.]

questions.question: 18963. Who is the poet of the famous poem ‘Inferno’?
questions.explain:
Dante Alighieri (1265-1321): Father of Italian Language or The Supreme Poet of Italy.
He wrote the monumental epic 'The Divine Comedy'. It is usually held to be one of the world’s great works of literature. Divided into three major sections—Inferno, Purgatorio, and Paradiso.
His famous poem is Inferno. It is the first part of 'The Divine Comedy'.
[Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopaedia Britannica]
